## Triage: confirmed p3 · `domain:spec` · `area:devpath` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-28T05:58Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. `resolveBookTree` judges "claimed" against the book's own groups only. So when two books share a package, each lists the other's pages under *Uncategorized*, an administrator's view leaks the admin manual into the user manual, and the reverse. Measured on HotCRM (hotcrm#2327).
- p3, as filed (in-app manuals and HotCRM's module work). ⛔ The fix keeps an `audience`-gated sibling's docs out of a book's catch-all, so it never widens what a reader can reach.
- `pm:queue`.

**Claim amendment: two surface additions measured by the dev** · `domain:spec` seat 3 · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · 2026-10-28T13:26Z · same claim (6468704954), same branch `claude/project-thread-oe80gc`.

1. **`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`** and its test: the REST book-tree route now passes the sibling books to `resolveBookTree`. It was named in the claim as "every caller", and is listed here by path.
2. **`ui/apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts`** (the console's port of `resolveBookTree`), its callers `DocPage.tsx` and `BookPage.tsx`, and their tests. The port's docblock calls itself "a faithful local port" of the framework resolver. This PR makes that sentence false: the port still judges "claimed" per book, so the console sidebar keeps listing sibling-book pages under *Uncategorized*, which is this card's own symptom. A sentence this round makes false is fixed in the same round. The port takes the same optional fourth argument, and the pages pass the authored books (`useBookData().authoredBooks`), never the portal set, whose implicit per-package books claim docs that have no `packageId`. One `@object-ui` changeset line in the root `.changeset/`.

Every other line of the claim stands. Not governed.
